parameters.name: newMode
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the new version of the page.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The type of the advanced configuration. Valid values:
\- online
\- offline (default)
